name: tabs
title: Native tab bar
summary: Replaces the stack shell with the system tab bar (UITabBarController / Material bottom navigation) holding Home and Account; top-level screens stay in `src/screens/`, so a tab is a thin route file.
when: The design has two or more top-level areas the user switches between.
claudeRules: Top-level screens live in `src/screens/`; tab routes in `src/app/(app)/(tabs)/` are one-line re-exports. Tab labels stay in the system font.
